sentences.text:
Applicant :- Lavkush
Opposite Party :- State Of U.P. Thru. Prin. Secy. Home, Lko.

And Others
Counsel for Applicant :- Nisha Srivastava

Counsel for Opposite Party :- G.A.
Hon'ble Mohd. Faiz Alam Khan,J.
Counter affidavit filed by the State is taken on record.

Earlier, the notices were issued to the opposite party Nos. 2, 3 & 4 and as per the report of office of date 07.02.2023, notices have been served to the opposite party Nos. 2, 3 & 4 sufficiently, however,
none is present for them.
Heard Ms. Nisha Srivastava, learned counsel for the accused-applicant as well as learned A.G.A. for the State and perused the record.

This bail application has been moved by the accused/applicant- Lavkush for grant of bail, in Case Crime No. 210 of 2022, under Sections 363, 366 & 376 I.P.C. and 3/4 POCSO Act, Police Station- Jahangirabad, District- Barabanki during trial.
Learned counsel for the accused-applicant submits that it is a case of false implication.

The first information report of the case was lodged by the father of the prosecutrix on 09.08.2022 at Police Station- Jahangirabad, District- Barabanki mentioning therein that his daughter aged about 17 years Lavkush vs State Of U.P. Thru. Prin. Secy. Home, ... on 20 February, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/91074746/
1 have been enticed away by the son of his brother-in-law, Lavkush, and one Narendra Kumar.

sentences.text: On 20.08.2022, the prosecutrix is shown to have been recovered alone and she refused to undergo any medical examination and in her statement recorded under Sections 161 and 164 Cr.P.C., she stated to have gone with the applicant with her free wish and will as the applicant is known to her for the last one year and also that they have solemnized marriage in a temple and were living as husband and wife and also that she is in love with the applicant.
It is also stated that whatever sexual relations had taken place between them, the same had been established with her free wish and will.

Highlighting the above facts, it is vehemently submitted that the prosecutrix after being recovered,
in her statement recorded under Sections 161 and 164, had not imputed any allegation against the applicant where she stated to have accompanied the applicant with her free wish and volition and also that the sexual relations have also been established between them with her free wish and will.

It is further submitted that in the F.I.R., the age of the prosecutrix is shown as 17 years while in the statement of the prosecutrix recorded under Section 161 Cr.P.C., she had stated her age to be of 20 years and in her statement recorded under Section 164 Cr.P.C., she had stated her age to be of 17 years while as per her educational credentials, her date of birth is shown as 16.09.2005, by which she comes about a little less than 17 years.

Highlighting the above facts, it is vehemently submitted that in absence of any proof on the basis of which the date of birth of the prosecutrix was registered in the school, the age of the prosecutrix as shown in the F.I.R. or in her statement recorded under Section 164 Cr..P.C. may be taken and since she was a consenting party, no offence in fact has been committed by the applicant.
It is next submitted that applicant is languishing in jail in this case since 24.08.2022 and he is not having any criminal history.
Charge sheet in this case has already been filed and there is no apprehension that after being released on bail he may flee from the course of law or may otherwise misuse the liberty.
Learned A.G.A., however, opposes the prayer of bail of the applicant on the ground that the applicant has committed an heinous offence and, therefore, he is not entitled to be released on bail.

Having heard learned counsel for the parties and having perused the record, it is evident that the age of the prosecutrix is shown in the F.I.R. as 17 years while in her statement recorded under Sections 161 and 164 Cr.P.C., she had stated her age to be of 20 years and 17 years respectively.
Her date of birth as per her educational credentials is 16.09.2005 whereby she comes about a little less than 17 years.

The prosecutrix was a consenting party as it is evident from her statement recorded under Sections 161 and 164 Cr.P.C wherein she had categorically stated to have accompanied the applicant on her own free volition and have also subjected herself to sexual relations with her free wish and will.
Applicant is languishing in jail in this case since 24.08.2022 without any criminal antecedents.
Charge sheet in this case has also been filed and the presence of the applicant may be secured before the trial court by placing adequate conditions.

sentences.text: Keeping in view the nature of the offence, evidence, complicity of the accused, severity of punishment, submissions of the learned counsel for the parties and without expressing any opinion on the merits of the case, I am of the considered view that applicant has made out a case for bail.
The bail application is thus allowed.

Let the accused/applicant- Lavkush involved in above-mentioned case, be released on bail on his furnishing a personal bond with two sureties in the like amount to the satisfaction of the court concerned subject to following conditions:-
(i) The applicant shall not tamper with the prosecution evidence by intimidating/pressurizing the witnesses, during the investigation or trial.
(ii) The applicant shall cooperate in the trial sincerely without seeking any adjournment.
(iii) The applicant shall not indulge in any criminal activity or commission of any crime after being released on bail.
In case of breach of any of the above conditions, it shall be a ground for cancellation of bail.
Identity, status and residence proof of the applicant and sureties be verified by the Court concerned before the bonds are accepted.
Observations made herein-above by this court are only for the purpose of disposal of this bail application and shall not be construed as an expression on the merits of the case.
